findings.failure_scenario: A machine config ($SKM_HOME/config/config.toml or ~/.config/swissknifeman/config.toml) contains schema_version = 1 and [harness.hooks.pack_guard] mode = "strict", and the project .swissknifeman/config.toml sets policy_profile = "base". Every hook leaf, including provider overrides, has x-skm-layers ["defaults", "project"], so aicore.config.model._allowed raises CONFIG_LAYER_FORBIDDEN. harness hooks show --target P --json and harness hooks sync exit via hooks.py:2662 and hooks.py:2628. settings_audit.read_policy_declaration catches that ConfigError, warns HARNESS_CONFIG_INVALID, and does not return the project policy_profile. The contract requires every hook key on the project layer and on the machine layer as a user default. The candidate test test_a_machine_layer_key_is_refused expects this exit.
findings.reproduction: Static: packages/harness/tests/test_hooks_env.py:245 writes the machine key under SKM_HOME and expects SystemExit from hooks show. Not re-run in this review.
